resources.string:
Enable the accessibility service, then turn on protection below.

Your screen is protected from side viewing angles while the notification drawer or Quick Settings is open. Closing the panel removes protection.

Supports the Galaxy S26 Ultra. Lock-screen activation is not included. Protection during the first frames of the opening swipe remains unverified.
Protects the screen while the unlocked notification drawer is open. Uses window metadata and System UI view identifiers to detect the drawer. Does not inspect notification text.
Enable Blinkers in Accessibility settings first.
Protection enabled. Waiting for the drawer.
